## C# client and helper contracts

### Client construction and lifetime

`AssinafyClientOptions` accepts `ApiKey` or `Token` (mutually exclusive), an optional default `AccountId`, an HTTPS `BaseUrl` whose path is exactly `/v1`, and a positive `Timeout` (or `Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan`). `new AssinafyClient(options)` owns its transport and applies `Timeout`; `new AssinafyClient(options, httpClient)` leaves the supplied transport open, leaves its timeout unchanged, and requires its `BaseAddress` to match `BaseUrl`. A supplied API-key transport must have automatic redirects disabled.

`AssinafyClient.Create(apiKey, accountId, configure)` is the API-key shorthand. `AssinafyClient.FromConfig(config)` accepts `api_key`/`apiKey`, `account_id`/`accountId`, `token`/`access_token`/`accessToken`, and `base_url`/`baseUrl`. Dispose the client when it owns its transport; a supplied client's lifetime stays with its owner.

The package has no NuGet dependencies and ships no container adapter. For dependency injection, register a named `HttpClient` with `ConfigurePrimaryHttpMessageHandler(AssinafyClient.CreatePrimaryHandler)` and `SetHandlerLifetime(Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan)`, then register `AssinafyClient` as a singleton over `IHttpClientFactory.CreateClient`. `AssinafyClient.CreatePrimaryHandler()` is public and returns the SDK's own handler: automatic redirects disabled, five-minute pooled connection lifetime, TLS 1.2 or 1.3 only. See the README for the full registration. Limit any retry policy on that client to safe methods, and make OAuth token and revoke calls through a separate client constructed without an `HttpClient`: its transport is `CreatePrimaryHandler()` alone, outside `IHttpClientFactory`, so no retry or hedging handler — one registered with `ConfigureHttpClientDefaults` included — can resend them.

Every constructed client exposes `Authentication`, `OAuth`, `Accounts`, `Users`, `Documents`, `Envelopes`, `Embed`, `Contracts`, `Signers`, `Assignments`, `Templates`, `Tags`, `Fields`, `PublicDocuments`, `Signing`, `Signatures`, and `Webhooks`.

### SDK errors

A supplied `HttpClient` must keep `Authorization`, `X-Api-Key`, and `Cookie` out of its default headers. Requests reject these inherited credentials with `ValidationException`; configure credentials through `AssinafyClientOptions`.

- Malformed credentials and SDK-validated request values throw `ValidationException` before transport; `Code` carries a stable machine-readable code when documented, and required .NET arguments use `ArgumentNullException` or `ArgumentException`.
- A request body that cannot be encoded as JSON throws `SerializationException` before transport.
- HTTP/API-envelope failures throw `ApiException`, with status, message, and structured details when supplied, plus `RateLimitLimit`, `RateLimitRemaining`, `RateLimitReset`, and `RetryAfter` from the rate-limit headers (`429` carries `Retry-After`).
- Transport failures and client-side request timeouts throw `NetworkException`.
- A successful response with an invalid envelope, missing required data, or incompatible JSON throws `SerializationException`.

### Upload-and-request helper

`UploadAndRequestSignaturesAsync` executes upload, optional readiness polling, signer creation, and assignment creation. Its request object is:

```csharp
new UploadAndRequestSignaturesOptions
{
    FileStream = pdf,                         // required Stream
    FileName = "contract.pdf",               // required PDF name
    AccountId = accountId,                    // optional account override
    WaitForReady = true,                      // default true
    Method = AssignmentMethods.Virtual,       // virtual or collect
    Message = "Please sign",                 // optional
    ExpiresAt = "2026-12-31T23:59:59Z",      // optional ISO-8601
    CopyReceivers = [copyReceiverSignerId],   // optional existing signer IDs
    Entries = null,                           // collect entries with known signer IDs
    EntriesFactory = signerIds =>             // or build entries from new signer IDs
    [
        new AssignmentEntry
        {
            PageId = "page-id",
            Fields =
            [
                new AssignmentEntryField
                {
                    SignerId = signerIds[0],
                    FieldId = "field-id",
                },
            ],
        },
    ],
    Signers =
    [
        new UploadAndRequestSignaturesSigner
        {
            FullName = "Example Signer",
            Email = "signer@example.com",
            GovernmentId = null,                  // CPF for biometrics; CPF/CNPJ for certificates
            WhatsAppPhoneNumber = null,
            VerificationMethod = SignerChannels.Email,
            NotificationMethods = [SignerChannels.Email],
            Step = 1,
        },
    ],
}
```

The response is `UploadAndRequestSignaturesResult`: `Document` is the ready `DocumentDetails` when waiting is enabled, otherwise the upload response; `SignerIds` contains every created signer ID in request order, and `Assignment` is the created `Assignment`. The API has no transaction across these calls; successful earlier resources remain when a later request fails.

### Local convenience methods

| Method | Input | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `Documents.WaitUntilReadyAsync` | document ID, optional maximum wait and poll interval | The latest `DocumentDetails`; throws for terminal failure or timeout. |
| `Documents.IsFullySignedAsync` | document ID | `bool`, derived from assignment summary or signer completion flags. |
| `Documents.GetSigningProgressAsync` | document ID | `SigningProgress` with `Signed`, `Total`, `Pending`, and `Percentage`. |
| `WebhookSignature.Verify` (`Assinafy.Sdk.Webhooks`) | endpoint `whsec_` secret, `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, and `webhook-signature` header values, raw body; optional `TimeSpan? tolerance` (default 5 minutes) and `TimeProvider? timeProvider` | `bool`: `true` when any `v1,` signature matches (constant-time HMAC-SHA256 comparison) and the timestamp is within the tolerance. Makes no network call. |
| `WebhookEvent` (`Assinafy.Sdk.Models`) | a verified delivery body, deserialized with `System.Text.Json` | `Id` (long), `Event`, `Message`, `Payload` (`JsonElement?`; an event without parameters may send `[]`), `Origin` (`JsonElement?`), `CreatedAt` (Unix seconds), `Subject` and `Object` (`JsonElement`, each with a `type` discriminator), `AccountId`. |
| `Signers.FindByEmailAsync` | email and optional account ID | First exact case-insensitive `Signer`, or `null`; follows every server page. |
| `Dispose` | none | Disposes only an SDK-owned `HttpClient`; a supplied client remains usable. |

## Contract lifecycle management

`AssinafyClient.Contracts` provides the six contract operations. Tracking belongs to an existing workspace document and never uploads or sends it for signature. Reads require `documents:read`; writes require `documents:write` and a plan with contract tracking.

`GetAsync` and `SetAsync` return `ContractRecord`: inspect whether it is a `DocumentContract` or `DocumentContractAmendment`. `ListAsync` returns `PaginatedResult<DocumentContract>`; `GetRelatedAsync`, `RenewAsync`, and `TerminateAsync` return the root `DocumentContract`. Contract dates are `YYYY-MM-DD` strings, monetary values are nullable `decimal`, and `UpdatedAt` is the API's timestamp for optimistic concurrency. Amendment `Terms` holds the delta and `Changes` maps field names to `ContractFieldChange.From`/`To` JSON values.

Write bodies use `IDictionary<string, object?>` with API snake_case keys so omission and explicit `null` stay distinct. Omitted attributes are unchanged; `null` clears a root term, resets `auto_renew` to false, or resets `currency` to BRL while a value is set. `status` cannot be null. A pending amendment instead drops a delta key when it is null; `parent_document_id: null` unlinks that pending instrument. Metadata and external references replace their whole collections. The [input schema](#schema-documentcontractinput) lists every attribute, length, range, and relation-specific restriction.

Send the read `updated_at` to have stale writes rejected as `409` with `ContractChanged`. Renew with the current `term` or an explicit later `end_date`; the SDK never retries a renewal. An expired contract can renew; a terminated contract cannot. Contract validation errors preserve the server's field/code entries in `ApiException.Details`.

The full [contract guidance](#contracts), operation payloads, and eight `document_contract_*` webhook examples describe lifecycle timing, plan lapses, owner notifications, signed instruments, and synchronization using `updated_at`.

## Identity verification flow

`SignerChannels.IdDocumentFaceMatchBasic` selects hosted government-document, face-match, and liveness verification. It requires the account feature and a valid CPF in `GovernmentId`, plus exactly one Email or Whatsapp notification. Assignment and template cost estimates include the per-signer fee; restarting an expired capture session does not charge again.

The signer calls `Signing.GetIdentityVerificationAsync(code)`, then `StartIdentityVerificationAsync(code, consent)` only after explicit biometric-processing consent. Both use only `signer-access-code`. Capture URLs are bearer links: preserve the full URL and fragment, open them as-is, and never log or persist them in browser storage. Only an absent or Expired session can start; Pending, InReview, Approved, Declined, and Abandoned cannot. Declined or Abandoned requires a new document and assignment.

InReview permits signing but holds certification. When all signers have signed, the document remains `pending_identity_review` until every review is approved. The workspace uses `Assignments.GetIdentityReviewAsync`, `DownloadIdentityReviewImageAsync`, and `DecideIdentityReviewAsync`; images exist only during InReview and must not be cached or logged. Third-party OAuth applications can read the summary but cannot fetch evidence or decide reviews; these operations require an API key or user session. Decisions are Approved or Rejected, with an optional private note of at most 2000 Unicode characters. Rejection cancels the document as `rejected_by_user` and notifies signers and copy receivers. The five `signer_identity_*` webhook events below report verification and review outcomes.

## Template and digital-certificate payloads

The signer certificate routes use only `signer-access-code` and never receive configured client credentials. They are production-only deployed extensions: the sandbox does not expose them, and they are not included in the published OpenAPI document. A valid production `DigitalCertificate` assignment and browser-signed Web PKI token are required for the complete flow.

`DigitalCertificate` signers require assignment method `virtual`. `AssignmentResource.CreateAsync`
and `EstimateCostAsync` reject another method before transport with `ValidationException.Code`
`digital_certificate_requires_virtual`. A template with any placed field is instantiated as a
`collect` assignment and is therefore incompatible with `DigitalCertificate`; use a template with
no placed fields for certificate signers.

### POST /v1/accounts/{accountId}/templates

Authentication: bearer token or `X-Api-Key`.

Request body: required `multipart/form-data` with exactly one `file` part containing a PDF. `TemplateResource.CreateAsync` uses an optional display name as the part filename and adds a `.pdf` suffix when needed; it does not send a second form field.

```http
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="Sales agreement.pdf"
Content-Type: application/pdf

<PDF bytes>
```

Success: `200` with a standard JSON envelope whose `data` is `TemplateDetails`. The create and update responses may omit `default_document_tags`; that property is returned by the GET-by-ID route.

```json
{
  "status": 200,
  "message": "",
  "data": {
    "resource": "template",
    "id": "template-id",
    "name": "Sales agreement.pdf",
    "document_name": null,
    "message": "Please review and sign",
    "status": "ready",
    "pages": [
      {
        "id": "page-id",
        "number": 1,
        "height": 1684,
        "width": 1191,
        "download_url": "https://example.com/template-page.jpg",
        "fields": [
          {
            "id": "placement-id",
            "field_id": "field-id",
            "role_id": "role-id",
            "label": "Signature",
            "display_settings": { "x": 100, "y": 200 },
            "created_at": "2026-08-26T12:00:00Z",
            "updated_at": null
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "roles": [
      {
        "id": "role-id",
        "name": "Signer",
        "assignment_type": "Signer",
        "created_at": "2026-08-26T12:00:00Z",
        "updated_at": null
      }
    ],
    "tags": [],
    "created_at": "2026-08-26T12:00:00Z",
    "updated_at": null
  }
}
```

Errors: invalid PDF uploads use the standard `400` JSON error envelope, missing or invalid credentials use `401`, and server failures use the standard JSON error envelope. The SDK rejects invalid PDF names, seekable payloads over 25 MB, and successful responses without a template ID before returning a result.

### GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/templates/{templateId}

Authentication: bearer token or `X-Api-Key`.

Request body: none.

Success: `200` with the full `TemplateDetails` envelope shown above plus `data.default_document_tags`, an array of tags automatically applied to documents created from the template:

```json
{
  "status": 200,
  "message": "",
  "data": {
    "resource": "template",
    "id": "template-id",
    "name": "Sales agreement.pdf",
    "document_name": null,
    "message": "Please review and sign",
    "status": "ready",
    "pages": [],
    "roles": [],
    "tags": [],
    "default_document_tags": [],
    "created_at": "2026-08-26T12:00:00Z",
    "updated_at": null
  }
}
```

Errors: missing or invalid credentials use the standard `401` JSON error envelope; an unknown template uses `404`; server failures use the standard JSON error envelope.

### PUT /v1/accounts/{accountId}/templates/{templateId}

Authentication: bearer token or `X-Api-Key`.

Request body: required `application/json` object containing `name`, `message`, or both. `TemplateResource.UpdateAsync` omits properties whose values are `null`.

```json
{
  "name": "Sales agreement v2",
  "message": "Please review and sign"
}
```

Success: `200` with the `TemplateDetails` envelope shown under POST. `default_document_tags` is optional on this response.

Errors: invalid properties use the standard `400` JSON error envelope, missing or invalid credentials use `401`, an unknown template uses `404`, and server failures use the standard JSON error envelope.

### DELETE /v1/accounts/{accountId}/templates/{templateId}

Authentication: bearer token or `X-Api-Key`.

Request body: none.

Success: `200` with a standard successful no-data envelope:

```json
{ "status": 200, "message": "", "data": null }
```

Errors: missing or invalid credentials use the standard `401` JSON error envelope; an unknown template uses `404`; server failures use the standard JSON error envelope.

### GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/templates/{templateId}/pages/{pageId}/download

Authentication: bearer token or `X-Api-Key`.

Request body: none.

Success: `200` with raw `image/jpeg` bytes and no JSON envelope.

Errors: missing or invalid credentials use the standard `401` JSON error envelope; an unknown template or page uses `404`; server failures use the standard JSON error envelope instead of image bytes.

### POST /v1/signers/certificate/start

Authentication: signer access code. Configured bearer and API-key credentials are not sent.

Request body: required `application/json`. `SigningResource.StartCertificateAsync` sends the access code in both the query and body:

```http
POST /v1/signers/certificate/start?signer-access-code=access-code
Content-Type: application/json

{ "signer-access-code": "access-code" }
```

Success: `200` with a standard JSON envelope whose `data.token` is the Web PKI operation token:

```json
{ "status": 200, "message": "", "data": { "token": "web-pki-token" } }
```

Errors: an invalid or expired signer access code uses the standard `401` JSON error envelope; an invalid signing state or request uses `400`; server failures use the standard JSON error envelope.

### POST /v1/signers/certificate/complete

Authentication: signer access code. Configured bearer and API-key credentials are not sent.

Request body: required `application/json`. `SigningResource.CompleteCertificateAsync` sends the browser-signed token:

```http
POST /v1/signers/certificate/complete?signer-access-code=access-code
Content-Type: application/json

{ "signer-access-code": "access-code", "token": "signed-web-pki-token" }
```

Success: `200` with a standard JSON envelope whose `data.signerName` identifies the certificate signer:

```json
{ "status": 200, "message": "", "data": { "signerName": "Certificate Signer" } }
```

Errors: an invalid or expired signer access code uses the standard `401` JSON error envelope; an invalid signed token or signing state uses `400`; server failures use the standard JSON error envelope. For example: `{ "status": 400, "message": "Invalid request", "data": {} }`.

{
  "tags": [

  "summary": "Create assignment (request signatures)",
  "description": "Request signatures on a document. Use `method: virtual` to sign without input fields, or `method: collect` to place input fields on specific pages.\n\n**Digital certificate signing works only on `virtual` assignments.** A `DigitalCertificate` signer cannot sign placed fields, so a `collect` assignment with one is refused with `400` before anything is charged.\n\nA document takes one assignment: a retry after a lost response answers `400` and charges nothing. Read the document to see whether the first request went through.\n\nFor **virtual**, the document may be in `uploaded`, `metadata_processing` or `metadata_ready`; it is promoted to `pending_signature` automatically once metadata processing completes. For **collect**, the document must be in `metadata_ready` (fields reference specific pages).\n\n`step` controls signing order: signers sharing a step sign in parallel, and the next step is notified only after the previous step completes. If supplied, every signer must supply it and values must be contiguous starting at 1.",
  "operationId": "d1293d781c9d94ec8b8c43d540c99ef4",

                  "verification_method": {
                    "description": "How the signer's identity is verified before signing. `Email` (default) sends a one-time code to the signer's email; `Whatsapp` sends the code over WhatsApp — the verification itself is not billed, but it requires the WhatsApp notification channel, so the signer costs 0.45 credits (available only on paid subscriptions); `DigitalCertificate` has the signer sign with their own ICP-Brasil certificate (A1/A3) — it requires the Digital Certificate feature, the signer must have a CPF or CNPJ in `government_id`, must be alone in its signing step, needs `method: virtual` (a `collect` assignment with a `DigitalCertificate` signer returns `400`), and is charged 0.5 credits per signer. A CPF requires that person's certificate (an e-CPF, or an e-CNPJ naming them as legal representative); a CNPJ requires an e-CNPJ for that company, from any of its representatives. `IdDocumentFaceMatchBasic` verifies the signer from a photo of their government ID, a photo of them holding it and a liveness check — it requires the ID Document + Face Match feature, the signer must have a valid CPF in `government_id`, and is charged a per-signer fee. WhatsApp incurs an additional cost and is available only on paid subscriptions. Omit it to have it inferred from `verification_method`, or `{\"Email\"}` when neither is sent. See **Verification & Notification Methods** for the full pairing table.",
                    "type": "array",

### GET /v1/documents/{documentId}/assignments/{assignmentId}/signers/{signerId}/identity-verification

```json
{
  "tags": [
    "Assignments"
  ],
  "summary": "Signer identity review",
  "description": "The signer's identity-document verification as the account's reviewer sees it. When the provider sends a verification to review, the account decides it with **Decide signer identity review**. The signer can still view and sign meanwhile; the review holds the document's certification instead (status `pending_identity_review` once every signer has signed).\nEvidence is a summary kept by Assinafy (no images or biometrics). `evidence_available` is false when the provider keeps none or it could not be fetched yet. While the review is open, `images` lists the evidence images the reviewer can open with **Signer identity review image**. A verification the provider approved directly, without a review, shows no evidence here (`evidence_available` is false); its evidence is on the `signer_identity_verified` activity. For a document of an envelope, the signer's one check of the whole envelope, read from any of its documents they are on. Reachable with the `documents:read` OAuth scope; the images and the decision are not available to third-party OAuth applications (`403`): the review is made by a person, in Assinafy or its apps.",

### POST /v1/documents/{documentId}/assignments/{assignmentId}/signers/{signerId}/identity-verification/review

```json
{
  "tags": [
    "Assignments"
  ],
  "summary": "Decide signer identity review",
  "description": "Approves or rejects a signer whose identity verification is `InReview`, while the document is `pending_signature` or `pending_identity_review`. Approved: once every signer has signed and no other signer is under review, the document is certificated; the certificate states the approval by review and every difference found. Rejected: the document is cancelled (`rejected_by_user`, with the reviewer as the user) and every signer and copy receiver gets the cancellation notice; the note is never shown to them. The signer gets no message about the decision itself. For a document of an envelope, it decides the signer's one check of the whole envelope, from any of its documents they are on, and is recorded on each of them: approving releases each once signed, and rejecting cancels the whole envelope as its cancel does, each person told once. The decision is also reported to the verification provider. Not available to third-party OAuth applications (`403`), whatever their scopes: the certificate names the person who reviewed. Assinafy's own apps can decide it with the `documents:write` scope, and the reviewer is the user signed in to them.",
  "operationId": "f289acdd56b407dc925f0464b0564e1a",
  "parameters": [
    {
      "$ref": "#/components/parameters/DocumentId"
    },
    {
      "name": "assignmentId",
      "in": "path",
      "description": "The assignment ID.",
      "required": true,
      "schema": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "signerId",
      "in": "path",
      "description": "The signer ID.",
      "required": true,
      "schema": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    }
  ],
  "requestBody": {
    "required": true,
    "content": {
      "application/json": {
        "schema": {
          "required": [
            "decision"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "decision": {
              "type": "string",
              "enum": [
                "Approved",
                "Rejected"
              ],
              "example": "Approved"
            },
            "note": {
              "description": "Optional. Recorded in the activity log and sent to the provider; never shown to the signer.",
              "type": [
                "string",
                "null"
              ],
              "maxLength": 2000,
              "example": "Conferido por videochamada."
            }
          },
          "type": "object"
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "responses": {
    "200": {
      "description": "Decided",
      "content": {
        "application/json": {
          "schema": {
            "type": "object",
            "allOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Envelope"
              },
              {
                "properties": {
                  "data": {
                    "$ref": "#/components/schemas/SignerIdentityReview"
                  }
                },
                "type": "object"
              }
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "400": {
      "description": "Invalid decision, the verification is not `InReview`, or the document is no longer awaiting signatures (for a document of an envelope, none of the signer's documents of it is).",
      "content": {
        "application/json": {
          "schema": {
            "type": "object",
            "allOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope"
              },
              {
                "properties": {
                  "status": {
                    "type": "integer",
                    "example": 400
                  },
                  "message": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "example": "decision must be Approved or Rejected."
                  }
                },
                "type": "object"
              }
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "403": {
      "$ref": "#/components/responses/Forbidden"
    },
    "404": {
      "description": "Assignment, signer or verification not found.",
      "content": {
        "application/json": {
          "schema": {
            "type": "object",
            "allOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope"
              },
              {
                "properties": {
                  "status": {
                    "type": "integer",
                    "example": 404
                  },
                  "message": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "example": "Identity verification not found."
                  }
                },
                "type": "object"
              }
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "401": {
      "$ref": "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
    },
    "500": {
      "$ref": "#/components/responses/ServerError"
    }
  },
  "security": [
    {
      "bearerAuth": []
    },
    {
      "apiKeyAuth": []
    }
  ]
}

### PUT /v1/accounts/{accountId}/documents/{documentId}/contract

```json
{
  "tags": [
    "Contracts"
  ],
  "summary": "Set a document's contract terms",
  "description": "Creates the document's contract terms, or changes only the attributes sent (see the request body for what `null` does). `external_references`, when sent, replaces the whole list. Records a `document_contract_updated` event when the terms change; a retry that changes nothing records none. The body must be a JSON object with at least one attribute. With `parent_document_id`, the document is instead linked as an amendment, renewal or termination of that contract (or of any document in its family, resolved to the root) and the other attributes are the terms it changes; a later `PUT` on a pending amendment merges into that delta (a `null` drops a key) and `parent_document_id: null` unlinks it; every change to the link records `document_contract_amendment_updated` on this document. The delta applies to the parent once the document is certificated (at once, if it already is), in signing order (the order the documents' certifications were recorded in, fixed for each once it is; a certificated document with none recorded waits, and is placed by its certification time an hour on): instruments signed earlier apply first, one that cannot holds the later ones back, and an instrument signed before one already applied is blocked instead of applied over it. Applying records `document_contract_amended`; an applied amendment is read-only. A cancelled, declined or expired document takes no new terms and no new link; terms or a link already on one stay and can still change. Send the `updated_at` you read with the write to have it refused (`409`) if the contract or link changed meanwhile. Contract tracking comes with every standard plan, the free plan too; `403` when the workspace's current subscription lacks it.",

### POST /v1/accounts/{accountId}/documents/{documentId}/contract/renew

```json
{
  "tags": [
    "Contracts"
  ],
  "summary": "Renew a contract",
  "description": "Starts the contract's next term: `end_date` moves by `renewal_term_months` (12 when unset), or to the `end_date` sent, which must be after the current one. A `value` sent replaces the current one. Reopens an expired contract; a terminated one returns `400`. Steps `term`, so the lifecycle alerts run again for the new term. Records a `document_contract_renewed` event. Contract tracking comes with every standard plan, the free plan too; `403` when the workspace's current subscription lacks it. The body names the `term` the renewal starts from (the contract's current one) or the `end_date` it renews to, so a renewal answered with a `5xx` error, or whose answer was lost, is safe to send again: the repeat is refused with `400`, as the contract is then in its next term and that date is no longer after the current one (or with `409`, when it sends the `updated_at` it read).",
  "operationId": "af4dd6ad7298c3c17c47e7070c30a8da",
  "parameters": [
    {
      "$ref": "#/components/parameters/AccountId"
    },
    {
      "$ref": "#/components/parameters/DocumentId"
    }
  ],
  "requestBody": {
    "required": false,
    "content": {
      "application/json": {
        "schema": {
          "properties": {
            "end_date": {
              "description": "The new end date, after the current one. Absent, empty or `null`: the current end date plus the renewal term, stepped until it is in the future; `term` is then required.",
              "type": [
                "string",
                "null"
              ],
              "format": "date"
            },
            "value": {
              "description": "The new value; unchanged when not sent, cleared by `null`.",
              "type": [
                "number",
                "null"
              ]
            },
            "term": {
              "description": "The term this renewal starts from, the contract's current `term`. Required unless `end_date` is sent; for a contract in another term the renewal is refused, so a repeated request never renews twice.",
              "type": "integer",
              "minimum": 1,
              "example": 1
            },
            "updated_at": {
              "description": "Optional precondition: the contract's `updated_at` as read. Changed since: `409`, nothing renewed.",
              "type": "string",
              "format": "date-time",
              "example": "2026-10-23T12:00:00Z"
            }
          },
          "type": "object"
        },
        "examples": {

  "description": "The supported document statuses and whether a document in each status can be deleted.\n\n| Status | Deletable | Description |\n|--------|-----------|-------------|\n| `uploading` | no | The document upload is in process. |\n| `uploaded` | no | The document has been uploaded. |\n| `metadata_processing` | no | The initial processing is under way. |\n| `metadata_ready` | yes | The initial processing has been completed. |\n| `expired` | yes | The signature deadline has been reached. |\n| `certificating` | no | The document has been signed and is being certificated. |\n| `certificated` | no | The document is certificated. |\n| `rejected_by_signer` | yes | A signer declined signing the document. |\n| `pending_signature` | yes | The document is waiting for signatures. |\n| `pending_identity_review` | yes | Every signer has signed; the document waits for the account to review a signer's identity before it is certificated. Deleting it cancels it and notifies the signers. |\n| `rejected_by_user` | yes | The signature process was cancelled by a user. |\n| `failed` | yes | The document processing has failed. |",
  "operationId": "c21c2883aca1e1b6d1bcaea01fc63315",
  "responses": {
    "200": {
      "description": "Supported statuses",
      "content": {
        "application/json": {

            "type": "object",
            "allOf": [

              },
              {

### POST /v1/documents/{documentId}/assignments/{assignmentId}/signers/{signerId}/embed-sessions

```json
{
  "tags": [
    "Embedded Signing"
  ],
  "summary": "Create an embed session",
  "description": "Mint a single-use embed URL for a signer created with `embedded: true`. Load the URL in an iframe on one of the workspace's embed origins within 5 minutes; opening it spends the token, so mint a fresh one each time the signer opens the page. The signer's access code is never returned. Refused with `400` (`embed_not_enabled_for_signer`) for a signer that is not embedded, `409` when the signer already finished (`already_signed`), the document is still being uploaded or processed (`document_not_ready`: retry in a moment), the document can no longer be signed or the signer's step has not started (`document_unavailable`), or the workspace has no embed origin (`embed_origins_missing`), `403` with code `PlanRestricted` when the plan does not include embedded signing, and `429` after 30 sessions for one signer in an hour.",
  "operationId": "5d57fa2ec0166bd135783feda21141eb",
  "parameters": [
    {
      "$ref": "#/components/parameters/DocumentId"
    },
    {
      "name": "assignmentId",
      "in": "path",
      "description": "The assignment ID.",
      "required": true,
      "schema": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "signerId",
      "in": "path",
      "description": "The signer ID.",

      "schema": {
        "type": "string"
      }

  ],
  "responses": {

        "application/json": {
          "schema": {
            "type": "object",
            "allOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Envelope"
              },
              {
                "properties": {
                  "data": {
                    "$ref": "#/components/schemas/EmbedSession"
                  }
                },
                "type": "object"
              }
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "400": {
      "$ref": "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
    },
    "403": {
      "$ref": "#/components/responses/Forbidden"
    },
    "404": {
      "description": "The document, assignment or signer was not found."
    },
    "409": {
      "description": "The signer can not sign right now (`already_signed`, `document_not_ready`, `document_unavailable`), or the workspace has no embed origin (`embed_origins_missing`)."

### POST /v1/accounts/{accountId}/envelopes

```json
{
  "tags": [
    "Envelopes"
  ],
  "summary": "Create envelope",
  "description": "Send several documents to the same signers at once. Each document gets its own assignment and keeps its own status, certificate and downloads; one invitation goes to each signer, through the methods sent for them, for all the documents they are on, from the first of them. A send that fails is recorded on that signer's request (`notification_history`) and doesn't undo the envelope: `200` means the envelope was created, not that every invitation was delivered. The envelope is charged as one document, whatever its documents, each signer's notifications and identity check once for the whole envelope, and each digital-certificate signature on every document it is made on. Every document must be uploaded and processed (`metadata_ready`) with no assignment, and every listed signer must be on at least one document. Each document is signed on its virtual page or, with `collect`, on the fields placed on its pages, as on an assignment; a digital-certificate signer signs only virtual documents, alone on each. Needs the Envelopes feature on the workspace's plan (`403` with code `PlanRestricted` otherwise). A refused request creates and charges nothing; `errors` names every field at fault.",
  "operationId": "6c4e72a133c3f93240b24df1f910912a",
  "parameters": [
    {
      "$ref": "#/components/parameters/AccountId"
    },
    {
      "name": "Idempotency-Key",
      "in": "header",
      "description": "Any text, case-sensitive and new for each envelope you mean to create (a UUID, say). Retrying with the same key after a lost response answers the envelope the first request created, and creates and charges nothing, whatever the body says. A key belongs to its workspace and doesn't expire. `409` with code `IdempotencyKeyInUse` if the first request is still running: try again. An empty value counts as no key, as on template documents.",
      "required": false,
      "schema": {
        "type": "string",
        "example": "0f8fad5b-d9cb-469f-a165-70867728950e"
      }
    }
  ],
  "requestBody": {
    "required": true,
    "content": {
      "application/json": {
        "schema": {
          "$ref": "#/components/schemas/EnvelopeCreateRequest"
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "responses": {
    "200": {
      "description": "The created envelope",
      "content": {
        "application/json": {
          "schema": {
            "type": "object",
            "allOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Envelope"
              },
              {
                "properties": {
                  "data": {
                    "$ref": "#/components/schemas/DocumentEnvelope"
                  }
                },
                "type": "object"
              }
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "400": {
      "description": "Refused as sent; nothing was created or charged. Each field at fault is an entry of `errors` (a list refused as a whole is not read item by item), an item of a list named by its index (`documents[1].signer_ids`): `name`; `message` (not text); `signers` and `documents` (missing, empty, not a list, or more than 20 signers or 20 documents; `documents` also when its documents hold more than 2,000 fields between them, a virtual document's being one per signer, or more than 100 copy receivers); `signers[i].id` (missing, listed twice, not a signer of the workspace, or on no document); `signers[i].verification_method` (not a code); `signers[i].notification_methods` (not a list of codes); `signers[i].step` (sent at all); `documents[i].id` (missing, listed twice, or a document that can't take the assignment: not found, not `metadata_ready`, or already assigned); `documents[i].method` (other than `virtual` or `collect`); `documents[i].entries` (missing for `collect`, or not a list of pages with fields naming their `signer_id`); `documents[i].expires_at` (not text, a number or null); `documents[i].signer_ids` (missing, not a list of ids, a signer not listed once in `signers`, for `collect` not exactly the signers on its fields, or a digital-certificate signer on a `collect` document or with another signer). A page or field the assignment doesn't find on a `collect` document, a method code the platform doesn't know, a verification and notification that don't pair, a signer without the e-mail or WhatsApp number their method needs, an `embedded` other than `true`, `false`, `1` or `0` (`null` reads as left out, as on an assignment) or set for a signer verified other than by Bypass, Email or WhatsApp, a balance too low for the envelope, an `expires_at` or `copy_receiver_ids` the assignment refuses, and a document another request assigned or put back into processing meanwhile answer `400` with `message` only, as on an assignment.",
      "content": {
        "application/json": {
          "schema": {
            "allOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope"
              }
            ]
          },
          "example": {
            "status": 400,
            "message": "This signer is on no document.",
            "errors": [
              {
                "field": "signers[1].id",
                "code": "Invalid",
                "message": "This signer is on no document."
              }
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "403": {
      "$ref": "#/components/responses/EnvelopesFeatureForbidden"
    },
    "404": {
      "$ref": "#/components/responses/NotFound"
    },
    "409": {
      "description": "The envelope costs more than `max_total_credits` (`CreditCeilingExceeded`), or another request with this `Idempotency-Key` is still running (`IdempotencyKeyInUse`).",
      "content": {
        "application/json": {
          "schema": {
            "type": "object",
            "allOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope"
              },
              {
                "properties": {
                  "status": {
                    "type": "integer",
                    "example": 409
                  },
                  "code": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [
                      "CreditCeilingExceeded",
                      "IdempotencyKeyInUse"
                    ]
                  },
                  "total_credits": {
                    "description": "With `CreditCeilingExceeded`: what the envelope costs now.",
                    "type": "number",
                    "example": 1.5
                  },
                  "max_total_credits": {
                    "description": "With `CreditCeilingExceeded`: the ceiling it was sent with.",
                    "type": "number",
                    "example": 1
                  }
                },
                "type": "object"
              }
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "401": {
      "$ref": "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
    },
    "500": {
      "$ref": "#/components/responses/ServerError"
    }
  },
  "security": [
    {
      "bearerAuth": []
    },
    {

    }
  ]
}

### POST /v1/accounts/{accountId}/envelopes/{envelopeId}/documents

```json
{
  "tags": [
    "Envelopes"
  ],
  "summary": "Add document to envelope",
  "description": "Add a document to an open envelope for some of its signers. The document is checked as on creation: a `metadata_ready` document of the workspace with no assignment, signed on its virtual page or, with `collect`, on the fields placed in `entries`, with its own `expires_at` and `copy_receiver_ids`. An envelope holds up to 20 documents. It charges only its digital-certificate signatures, the envelope having paid for its document and its signers' notifications and identity checks when it was sent, and goes last in the envelope's order; a signer whose identity check the envelope approved is verified on it too. Each chosen signer is sent the envelope's invitation again, through the methods and with the link of their first invitation, now listing the new document, even once the document that invitation was sent from is taken out; the other signers hear nothing. The signers are the envelope's own: no one new joins once it was sent. Needs the Envelopes feature on the workspace's plan, as creating does. A refused request creates and charges nothing; `errors` names every field at fault.",
  "operationId": "80c4aa75bd8a80dadd208a999429b3aa",
  "parameters": [
    {
      "$ref": "#/components/parameters/AccountId"
    },
    {
      "$ref": "#/components/parameters/EnvelopeId"
    }
  ],
  "requestBody": {
    "required": true,
    "content": {
      "application/json": {
        "schema": {
          "type": "object",
          "allOf": [
            {
              "$ref": "#/components/schemas/EnvelopeDocumentRequest"
            },
            {
              "properties": {
                "max_total_credits": {
                  "description": "Optional ceiling on what this request may spend, as on an assignment: refused with `409` and code `CreditCeilingExceeded`, nothing created or charged, when the document costs more on its own. A value that is not a number of credits, zero or more, answers `400`; numeric text counts, as a form-encoded body sends it.",
                  "type": "number",
                  "minimum": 0,
                  "example": 1.5
                }
              },
              "type": "object"
            }
          ]
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "responses": {
    "200": {
      "description": "The envelope with the document added",
      "content": {
        "application/json": {
          "schema": {
            "type": "object",
            "allOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Envelope"
              },
              {
                "properties": {
                  "data": {
                    "$ref": "#/components/schemas/DocumentEnvelope"
                  }
                },
                "type": "object"
              }
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "400": {
      "description": "Refused as sent; nothing was created or charged. Each field at fault is an entry of `errors`: `id` (missing, or a document that can't take the assignment: not found, not `metadata_ready`, or already assigned); `method` (other than `virtual` or `collect`); `entries` (missing for `collect`, or not a list of pages with fields naming their `signer_id`); `signer_ids` (missing, not a list of ids, listed twice, not a signer of the envelope's documents, for `collect` not exactly the signers on its fields, or a digital-certificate signer on a `collect` document or with another signer); `expires_at` (not text, a number or null); a null `field` when the envelope already has 20 documents, or would hold more than 2,000 fields (a virtual document's being one per signer) or more than 100 copy receivers with this one. A page or field the assignment doesn't find on a `collect` document, a balance too low, an `expires_at` or `copy_receiver_ids` the assignment refuses, and a document another request assigned or put back into processing meanwhile answer `400` with `message` only, as on an assignment.",
      "content": {
        "application/json": {
          "schema": {
            "allOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope"
              }
            ]
          },
          "example": {

            "message": "Each of a document's signers must be listed once in the envelope's signers.",
            "errors": [
              {
                "field": "signer_ids",
                "code": "Invalid",
                "message": "Each of a document's signers must be listed once in the envelope's signers."
              }
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "403": {

    },
    "404": {

    },

{
  "tags": [
    "Authentication"
  ],
  "summary": "Confirm authenticator enrollment",
  "description": "Activates the method by proving one live code from the NEW device (`code`). Returns the recovery codes, which are shown only once and cannot be retrieved again. From this point every login requires a second factor. If the user already has a confirmed method of the same type, confirming REPLACES it — the old one is soft-deleted and recovery codes are reissued — so this call additionally requires re-authentication via `password` or `reauth_code` (a live code from the CURRENT device, or one of the existing recovery codes), exactly like disabling a method. First-time enrollment needs neither.",
  "operationId": "777393d6a37829f88147df5345af6175",

          "required": [

            "code"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "id": {
              "type": "string",
              "example": "a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90"
            },
            "code": {
              "description": "Live code from the NEW device being confirmed.",
              "type": "string",
              "example": "123456"
            },
            "password": {
              "description": "Re-authentication proof, required only when replacing an existing confirmed method.",
              "type": "string",
              "format": "password"
            },
            "reauth_code": {

          },
          "type": "object"
        }
      }

### POST /v1/oauth/token

```json
{
  "tags": [
    "OAuth"
  ],
  "summary": "Exchange a code, refresh token, or subject token for an access token",
  "description": "Implements the RFC 6749 §5.1/§5.2 token-endpoint body contract in\n     *         both directions: a successful exchange returns a flat JSON object with\n     *         `access_token` at the top level, and a failure returns a flat\n     *         `{error, error_description}` object — neither is wrapped in this API's\n     *         usual response envelope, since no standard OAuth client library (or MCP\n     *         connector) would find `access_token` or `error` inside a `data` key.\n     *\n     *         The third grant, `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange` (RFC 8693),\n     *         is restricted to a confidential internal-service client (see `/oauth/introspect`)\n     *         and trades a front-end resource's access token (the `subject_token`) for one\n     *         minted for THIS API — the crossing an MCP server makes after a user consents,\n     *         since its own token can never be forwarded here directly. The issued token is\n     *         never wider than the subject: `scope`, when sent, must be a subset of the\n     *         subject's own scopes, and `resource` must equal this API's own resource\n     *         identifier exactly. No refresh token is issued; the caller re-exchanges from\n     *         the user's own token instead of holding unattended API access.\n\nReplaying a refresh token already rotated ends the whole authorization. For Assinafy's own apps it ends that device's session.",
  "operationId": "b214b71efe5b11ac52d79597108ab2ba",
  "requestBody": {
    "required": true,
    "content": {
      "application/x-www-form-urlencoded": {
        "schema": {
          "$ref": "#/components/schemas/OAuthTokenRequest"
        }
      },
      "application/json": {
        "schema": {
          "$ref": "#/components/schemas/OAuthTokenRequest"
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "responses": {
    "200": {
      "description": "The token response",
      "content": {
        "application/json": {
          "schema": {
            "properties": {
              "access_token": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "issued_token_type": {
                "description": "Present only for the token-exchange grant, per RFC 8693 §2.2.1.",
                "type": "string",
                "example": "urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:access_token"
              },
              "token_type": {
                "type": "string",
                "example": "Bearer"
              },
              "expires_in": {
                "description": "For the token-exchange grant, clamped to the subject token's own remaining lifetime as well as the exchanged-token TTL — never longer than either.",
                "type": "integer",
                "example": 3600
              },
              "refresh_token": {
                "description": "Present only when the `offline_access` scope was requested AND consented on the authorization_code/refresh_token grants. Never present for the token-exchange grant. Without it a client must send the user through the authorization flow again once the access token expires.",
                "type": [
                  "string",
                  "null"
                ]
              },
              "scope": {
                "description": "The scope of the ACCESS token. `offline_access` is a request-time signal rather than a permission, so it never appears here even when it was requested.",
                "type": "string",
                "example": "documents:read"
              },
              "id_token": {
                "description": "A signed OIDC id_token (RS256). Present only when the openid scope was granted.",
                "type": [
                  "string",
                  "null"
                ]
              }
            },
            "type": "object"
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "400": {
      "description": "`invalid_grant` (bad, expired, replayed, or wrong-client authorization code; a `code_verifier` outside the RFC 7636 grammar of 43-128 unreserved characters; redirect_uri mismatch; a refresh token whose authorization no longer includes `offline_access`; for token-exchange, a `subject_token` that is unusable, itself an exchanged token, not visible to service clients, or expired), `invalid_target` (a `resource` this server does not issue tokens for, one disagreeing with the authorized value, or — for token-exchange — one other than this API's own resource identifier), `invalid_scope` (token-exchange only: the requested `scope` is not a subset of the subject token's own scopes), `invalid_request` (token-exchange only: an unsupported `subject_token_type`/`requested_token_type`), or `unsupported_grant_type`",
      "content": {
        "application/json": {
          "schema": {
            "properties": {
              "error": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "invalid_grant",
                  "invalid_target",
                  "invalid_scope",
                  "invalid_request",
                  "unsupported_grant_type"
                ]
              },
              "error_description": {
                "type": "string"
              }
            },
            "type": "object"
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "401": {
      "description": "`invalid_client` — unknown/disabled client or failed client authentication. The description never reveals whether client_id exists.",
      "content": {
        "application/json": {
          "schema": {
            "properties": {
              "error": {
                "type": "string",
                "example": "invalid_client"
              },
              "error_description": {
                "type": "string",
                "example": "Client authentication failed."
              }
            },
            "type": "object"
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "429": {
      "description": "Rate limit exceeded; wait the `Retry-After` seconds. Limited per caller IP."
    },
    "500": {
      "$ref": "#/components/responses/ServerError"
    }
  },
  "security": []
}
```

{
  "tags": [
    "OAuth"
  ],
  "summary": "Revoke a token",
  "description": "Revokes an access or refresh token. A refresh token ends the whole authorization; for Assinafy's own apps, it ends that device's session, and the authorization stays. Every token outcome always returns 200 — including a token that does not exist, is already revoked, or is malformed — so the endpoint can never be used to probe whether a token exists. The one exception is failed client authentication, which returns 401.",

        }
      }
    }

  "responses": {
    "200": {
      "description": "Revoked"
    },
    "401": {
      "description": "`invalid_client` — the only case that is not reported as success. Every token outcome (revoked, already revoked, unknown, malformed) always returns 200; only failed client authentication returns 401.",

          "schema": {
            "properties": {

}

{
  "tags": [
    "Signers"
  ],
  "summary": "Update signer",
  "description": "Update a signer's information. Only the fields sent change; send just the ones you are changing.\n\n**Clearing a field:** `null` or `\"` clears `email`, `whatsapp_phone_number` and `government_id` (`whatsapp_phone_number` is stored as `null` either way; the other two keep the value sent). `full_name` cannot be cleared.\n\n**Verification integrity:** `email` / `whatsapp_phone_number` cannot be changed while the signer has verified that channel on an in-flight (not yet certificated) document — the response is `400` naming the offending document(s). Already-certificated documents do not block updates, except a document of an envelope while another of the signer's documents of it is in flight. Changing a channel that has *unverified* in-flight requests, or unverified requests on a document of an envelope while another of the signer's documents of it is in flight, rotates their access/verification codes (invalidating previously sent links/OTPs); use the resend endpoint to redeliver. `full_name` can always be updated.",
  "operationId": "8b29918a9706391427301103b2a7551e",
  "parameters": [
    {
      "$ref": "#/components/parameters/AccountId"
    },
    {
      "name": "signerId",

      "description": "The signer ID.",

        "type": "string"
      }

              "example": "John Dove"
            },
            "email": {
              "description": "Can't be changed or cleared while the signer has verified it on an in-flight document, or on a document of an envelope while another of their documents of it is in flight (`400`).",
              "type": "string",
              "format": "email",
              "example": "john@example.com"
            },
            "whatsapp_phone_number": {
              "description": "E.164; normalized on save, and compared after normalizing, so the same number in another format is not a change. Can't be changed or cleared while the signer has verified it on an in-flight document, or on a document of an envelope while another of their documents of it is in flight (`400`).",
              "type": "string",
              "example": "+5548999990000"
            },
            "government_id": {
              "description": "Signer's CPF (11 digits) or CNPJ (14 characters; may be alphanumeric). Formatting is accepted and the value is normalized on save.",
              "type": "string",
              "example": "390.533.447-05"
            }
          },
          "type": "object"
        }

### GET /v1/signers/identity-verification

```json
{
  "tags": [
    "Signing"
  ],
  "summary": "Identity document verification status",
  "description": "Current state of the signer's identity document verification. Backfills a pending decision from the provider. Uses the signer access code.\n\n**One live session per signer:** `can_start` is true before a provider session exists, and again once that session is Expired -- the capture link lapsed before anything was submitted, so the signer may open a new one. Once a session is Pending, In Review, Approved, Declined or Abandoned it is false. A signer who reaches Declined or Abandoned cannot restart here; the account must start a whole new process (new document, new assignment). With the code of a document of an envelope, this is the signer's one check for the whole envelope, whichever of their codes of it asks.\n\n**In review:** the signer continues -- views, confirms their data and signs -- while the account reviews the result. The document is certificated only after the account approves every signer under review; if it rejects one, the document is cancelled and every signer receives the cancellation notice.",
  "operationId": "4a0c6db3f140fa5b1686cf20a39aa351",
  "responses": {
    "410": {
      "$ref": "#/components/responses/SignerAccessClosed"
    },

              },

                "properties": {

                      "status": {

                          "null"

                        "example": "Pending"

                        "type": [
                          "string",
                          "null"
                        ],
                        "example": "https://verify.assinafy.com.br/c/01a0ed77-2afe-7f4b-bca9-349edcf4bb99#t=token"

### POST /v1/signers/identity-verification

```json
{
  "tags": [
    "Signing"
  ],
  "summary": "Start identity document verification",
  "description": "Records the signer's biometric-processing consent and opens a provider session. Returns the hosted verification URL to redirect to. Uses the signer access code.\n\n**One live session per signer:** this succeeds when no session exists yet, or when the last one Expired (the capture link lapsed before anything was submitted); the expired session is replaced by a new one. Otherwise -- Pending, In Review, Approved, Declined or Abandoned -- it returns `400`. A resend never destroys or replaces a live provider session, and the account is billed once per signer at assignment creation, never again on a restart. Recovering from a Declined or Abandoned verification means the account must start a whole new process (new document, new assignment). With the code of a document of an envelope, it starts the signer's one check for the whole envelope: one session, whichever of their codes of it is used, billed once with the envelope.",
  "operationId": "bc5dd80e6d879e2d4cf4a648ba7a42c3",
  "requestBody": {
    "required": true,
    "content": {
      "application/json": {
        "schema": {
          "required": [
            "consent"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "consent": {
              "description": "Must be true. Explicit consent to biometric processing.",
              "type": "boolean",
              "example": true
            }
          },
          "type": "object"
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "responses": {
    "410": {
      "$ref": "#/components/responses/SignerAccessClosed"
    },
    "200": {
      "description": "Session created",
      "content": {
        "application/json": {
          "schema": {
            "type": "object",
            "allOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Envelope"
              },
              {
                "properties": {

{

Unlike `GET /v1/sign`, this answers before a certificate or identity-check signer confirms their data, so their link learns its envelope here.",

### GET /v1/sign

```json
{
  "tags": [
    "Signing"
  ],
  "summary": "View document to sign",
  "description": "Retrieve the document a signer has been invited to sign, using the signer access code. Marks the document as viewed. The assignment carries only this signer's items, and leaves out the other signers, their signing links (`signing_urls`), the copy receivers and the signing `summary`. The response adds `current_signer`: this signer, with their `verification_method`, `notification_methods` and `completed` (whether they have already signed). Returns 409 while the document is still being prepared (retry with backoff). Once the signer is done (signed, or the document was declined, cancelled, expired or failed; for a document of an envelope, with every document of the envelope they are on) for more than 30 minutes, or the workspace was deleted, the code is closed: this returns only `id`, `name`, `status`, `current_signer` and `certified_copy`, with `is_signer_access_closed: true` (and `envelope`, when asked for), and the signer's other endpoints answer `410`. `certified_copy` says whether the signer can ask for the certified copy again (`POST /v1/sign/certified-copy`): `available`, the `notification_method` it goes on and, for WhatsApp, `resends_left`.\n\n**Signers whose verification method is `DigitalCertificate`** must have confirmed their data *and* accepted the terms before this returns the document; otherwise it is `400`. Both are satisfied in one call to `PUT /v1/documents/{documentId}/signers/confirm-data` with `has_accepted_terms: true`, so send that before this endpoint — the `has_accepted_terms` query parameter here is too late to open the gate. `PUT /v1/signers/accept-terms` also works and is never gated.",
  "operationId": "ccc4f307d924837da054992e1dc35069",
  "parameters": [
    {
      "name": "has_accepted_terms",
      "in": "query",
      "description": "Set true to record terms acceptance.",
      "schema": {
        "type": "boolean"
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "expand",
      "in": "query",
      "description": "`envelope` adds the envelope the code belongs to, its id and name, also once the code is closed and when the code's own document was taken out (the code still reaches the rest); `null` for a link outside an envelope or whose envelope was deleted. Without it the document reads as it always has.",
      "required": false,
      "style": "form",
      "explode": false,
      "schema": {
        "type": "array",
        "items": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "envelope"
          ]
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "document_id",
      "in": "query",
      "description": "With the code of a document of an envelope: another document of that envelope the signer is on, to open in place of the code's own; the code's e-mail or WhatsApp verification is carried there, once. A value that is no document id (a list, or empty) answers `400`. Ignored with any other code.",
      "required": false,
      "schema": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    }
  ],
  "responses": {
    "200": {
      "description": "The document with the signer's assignment",
      "content": {
        "application/json": {
          "schema": {
            "type": "object",
            "allOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Envelope"
              },
              {
                "properties": {
                  "data": {
                    "$ref": "#/components/schemas/SigningDocument"
                  }
                },
                "type": "object"
              }
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "400": {
      "description": "A digital-certificate signer has not yet confirmed their data or accepted the terms, the signer's step has not started yet (sequential signing), or, with the code of a document of an envelope, `document_id` is no document id.",
      "content": {
        "application/json": {
          "schema": {
            "type": "object",
            "allOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope"
              },
              {
                "properties": {
                  "status": {
                    "type": "integer",
                    "example": 400
                  },
                  "message": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "example": "Signer data must be confirmed before viewing the document."
                  }
                },
                "type": "object"
              }
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "404": {

{

Uses the signer access code. 5 wrong codes within 15 minutes of the first one lock the request until those 15 minutes end: every attempt, the right code included, returns `429`. A right code clears the count. With the code of a document of an envelope, the code of the signer's envelope invitation is accepted too, and wrong codes on any of their documents of the envelope count together.",

{
  "tags": [

  ],
  "summary": "Download the document to sign",
  "description": "The original of a document the signer still has to sign, with their access code (`signer-access-code`). Only `original` is available (`403` otherwise): the certified copy is sent to the signer by e-mail or WhatsApp. A request without an access code, such as a link from an older completion e-mail, is redirected (`302`) to the expired-link page, with a `?token=` the page can ask for the certified copy with when the signer and document match a completed signature request.",
  "operationId": "e5b804eb68ec9ff78f77fb79e1e756f3",
  "parameters": [
    {
      "name": "signerId",
      "in": "path",
      "description": "The signer ID.",
      "required": true,
      "schema": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    {
      "$ref": "#/components/parameters/DocumentId"
    },
    {
      "name": "artifactName",
      "in": "path",
      "description": "Artifact type. Only `original`.",
      "required": true,
      "schema": {
        "type": "string",
        "enum": [
          "original"
        ]
      }
    }
  ],
  "responses": {
    "200": {
      "description": "The artifact binary",
      "content": {
        "application/pdf": {
          "schema": {
            "type": "string",
            "format": "binary"
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "302": {
      "description": "No access code: redirected to the expired-link page."
    },
    "403": {
      "description": "An artifact other than `original`.",
      "content": {
        "application/json": {
          "schema": {
            "type": "object",
            "allOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope"
              },
              {
                "properties": {
                  "status": {
                    "type": "integer",
                    "example": 403
                  },
                  "message": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "example": "The signed document is sent to the signer by e-mail or WhatsApp."
                  }
                },
                "type": "object"
              }
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "404": {
      "description": "The signer or the document is not the code's, or the code doesn't reach the document.",
      "content": {
        "application/json": {
          "schema": {
            "type": "object",
            "allOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope"
              },
              {
                "properties": {
                  "status": {
                    "type": "integer",
                    "example": 404
                  },
                  "message": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "example": "Document not found."
                  }
                },
                "type": "object"
              }
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "410": {
      "$ref": "#/components/responses/SignerAccessClosed",
      "description": "The signer finished (for a document of an envelope, every document of it they are on) more than 30 minutes ago; the code no longer opens the document."
    },
    "400": {
      "$ref": "#/components/responses/SignerStepPending",
      "description": "The signer's step has not started yet (sequential signing)."
    },
    "401": {
      "$ref": "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
    },
    "500": {
      "$ref": "#/components/responses/ServerError"
    }
  },
  "security": [
    {
      "signerAccessCode": []
    }
  ]
}

### POST /v1/sign/certified-copy

```json
{
  "tags": [
    "Signing"
  ],
  "summary": "Send the certified copy again",
  "description": "Sends the signer their certified document again, with a download link valid for 30 minutes. It goes on the channel of the signature request (e-mail when the request used e-mail, otherwise WhatsApp) and only to the e-mail or number the signing messages went to, never to a changed signer record. Works with the signer's access code after they signed, including once the code is closed and after the workspace is deleted. E-mail: once every 2 minutes and 10 times in 24 hours. WhatsApp: once per signature request; after that the signer must ask the sender. `certified_copy` on `GET /v1/sign` says whether it is available.",
  "operationId": "78a2db6f12cfde943f07ddc8724d7895",
  "requestBody": {
    "required": false,
    "content": {
      "application/json": {
        "schema": {
          "properties": {
            "document_id": {
              "description": "With the code of a document of an envelope: another document of that envelope the signer is on, whose certified copy to send, in place of the code's own. A value that is no document id (a list, or empty) answers `400`. Ignored with any other code.",
              "type": "string",
              "example": "615601fab04c0a3147bb1246"
            }
          },
          "type": "object"
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "responses": {
    "200": {
      "description": "Sent",
      "content": {
        "application/json": {
          "schema": {
            "type": "object",
            "allOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Envelope"
              },
              {
                "properties": {
                  "data": {
                    "properties": {
                      "available": {
                        "description": "Whether it can be asked for again.",
                        "type": "boolean"
                      },
                      "notification_method": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "enum": [
                          "Email",
                          "Whatsapp"
                        ]
                      },
                      "resends_left": {
                        "description": "WhatsApp re-sends left; null for e-mail.",
                        "type": [
                          "integer",
                          "null"
                        ]
                      },
                      "sent_to": {
                        "description": "The masked contact it went to.",
                        "type": "string",
                        "example": "j***@example.com"
                      }
                    },
                    "type": "object"
                  }
                },
                "type": "object"
              }
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "404": {
      "description": "`document_id` names a document outside the code's envelope, or one the signer is not on.",
      "content": {
        "application/json": {
          "schema": {
            "type": "object",
            "allOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope"
              },
              {
                "properties": {
                  "status": {
                    "type": "integer",
                    "example": 404
                  },
                  "message": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "example": "Document not found."
                  }
                },
                "type": "object"
              }
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "409": {
      "description": "The signer has not signed, the document is not certified yet, or the request has no e-mail or WhatsApp to send to (ask the sender).",
      "content": {
        "application/json": {
          "schema": {
            "type": "object",
            "allOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope"
              },
              {
                "properties": {
                  "status": {
                    "type": "integer",
                    "example": 409
                  },
                  "message": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "example": "The signed document is not ready yet."
                  }
                },
                "type": "object"
              }
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "429": {
      "description": "E-mail: asked again within 2 minutes or more than 10 times in 24 hours. WhatsApp: already re-sent once (ask the sender).",
      "content": {
        "application/json": {
          "schema": {
            "type": "object",
            "allOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope"
              },
              {
                "properties": {
                  "status": {
                    "type": "integer",
                    "example": 429
                  },
                  "message": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "example": "The signed document was just sent. Wait a couple of minutes before asking again."
                  }
                },
                "type": "object"
              }
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "500": {
      "description": "The message could not be sent; nothing was used up, so it can be asked again.",
      "content": {
        "application/json": {
          "schema": {
            "type": "object",
            "allOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope"
              },
              {
                "properties": {
                  "status": {
                    "type": "integer",
                    "example": 500
                  },
                  "message": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "example": "The message could not be sent."
                  }
                },
                "type": "object"
              }
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "400": {
      "description": "The signer's step has not started yet (sequential signing), or, with the code of a document of an envelope, `document_id` is no document id.",
      "content": {
        "application/json": {
          "schema": {
            "type": "object",
            "allOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope"
              },
              {
                "properties": {
                  "status": {
                    "type": "integer",
                    "example": 400
                  }
                },
                "type": "object"
              }
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "401": {
      "$ref": "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
    }
  },
  "security": [
    {
      "signerAccessCode": []
    }
  ]
}
